description:
Motion graphics and visual effects; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe After Effects, rebuilt in pure Rust

Motion graphics and visual effects; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe After Effects, rebuilt in pure Rust.
EffectCraft is young: its first commit was on 1 October 2026. Nearly every After Effects feature exists, including all of its effects, but existing is not the same as behaving exactly like After Effects. Today it's a good place to try things and to tell us what breaks.
After Effects projects can't be opened. Projects are saved as .ecproj, readable versioned JSON, but EffectCraft can't open .aep / .aepx files, and After Effects plug-ins don't run.
What's Changed
- Export: write a colr atom in ProRes MOVs (#2801) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2804
- Shortcuts: panel and context scopes, one chord per scope by @pravdomil in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1266
- PDF import: the encryption pre-scan reads a bounded window after each trailer (#2142) by @becauseno7 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2679
- i18n(ja): the animator pop-up reads its own catalog rows by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2742
- docs(effects): the catalog's comments say what the Japanese interface does by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2758
- 3D animation: start keyed model clips at their activation time by @tylerjenningsw in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2759
- Expressions: expose source as an implicit current-layer attribute by @tylerjenningsw in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2771
- i18n(sv): translate 85 new strings by @kler in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2781
- Auto-Trace: map source-buffer outlines back into layer space by @tylerjenningsw in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2783
- UI: Save As starts from the open project's name, not Untitled (#2788) by @jonassneu in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2790
- fix(path): Wiggle Paths no longer overflows on an absurd speed, time or phase by @jayzed80 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2798
- Project files: the file envelope comes from craft-ecproj-format by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2792
- Fix #2823: Propagate boxes SAM 2 around the matte shown on the stroked frame by @arnav-hiwarkar in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2826
- Follow-up to #2823: box each of several objects around its whole matte on correction frames by @arnav-hiwarkar in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2830
- Restore GNOME Wayland window controls without bundled fonts by @danielmigueltejedor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1598
New Contributors
- @JonRC made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2804
- @danielmigueltejedor made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/1598
Full Changelog: https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/compare/v0.20.0...v0.21.0
